page.layout: One column of glossed verb entries, set right of centre, with the left side of the page blank. Page number and running head at the top. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: Confero, ich setze zusammen / ich streite/ confervi, confertum.
Curro,ich lauffe/ich fliesse/cucurri,curfum. Composita pleraq; duplicatione refpuut, paucis exceptis.
Defendo, ich beschirme/ich bewahre/ defendi, defensum.
Demo,ich nime weg/ich thue ab/ dempsi,demptū.
Decerpo, ich breche ab / ich lese ab/ decerpsi, decerptum.
Erubesco, ich werde schamrot/ erubui, absq; supino.
Edo, ich lasse aussgehn / ich gebe herfür / edidi, editum. (cursum.
Excudo, ich schmide auß / ich trucke / excudi, ex-cusum.

page.notes: Printed parenthetical references "(no." and "(cursum." sit at the right edge of their lines and are kept as printed. Some German glosses are hard to read at the scan resolution (e.g. "didìdi", "Diffindo" gloss); the Latin forms are readable. Mixed German type is set in roman, not black letter, so no bl markup. "confevi" appears as printed.
